summary:
Refactor plan to refine note creation and citation workflow:
- Clean up redundant "Make it a note" buttons across cards, reader, and growth sheets
- Transform "Include insights" into "Include citation" in the composer
- Dynamically query citations based on the user's configured Highlights folder setting
- Insert standard Obsidian citation callout blocks with wikilinks: > [!quote] [[Source]]
- Render citations as bounded editorial cards with title headers, quotation accents, and direct links
- Preserve graph engine integrity with automatic bidirectional citation indexing
